outlook.statement: The company is actively scouting for management of third party projects to earn project management fees which will lead to handsome rewards.

Town & Country-Harmonia Pavilion apartments are fast proceeding towards completion of construction and barring unforeseen circumstances, the construction is expected to be completed by November or December of this year. The company is sure to market the balance flats by March 2027 at a good price.
The company has now taken up some more land it owns for the purpose of launching Phase-III of Harmonia Senior villas.
The company will put special emphasis in marketing Harmonia Duplex Villas.

The company feels that it can construct and market substantial residential space, as apartments and villas in the destination Sriperumbudur as it gets more prominence and more families come to live there.

The company has signed agreements for the redevelopment of three apartment complexes in Chennai city. One of these projects has already received the necessary RERA approvals for construction and sales, and the market response has been positive. The company is quite certain that the other two projects will also have overwhelming response from the market.

Three city projects under implementation expected to yield turnover of over Rs.492 crores over next 24-30 months; additional re-development projects under negotiation; Sriperumbudur Phase-III of Harmonia senior villa project (48 units) contemplated; evaluating alternatives for 9.5 lakh sq.ft land including plotted land sales due to long-drawn high-rise development; new Chennai airport vicinity may dampen demand

Uncertainty from West Asia conflict affecting 3-4 million Indian workers and $100+ billion remittances; oil supply disruption from Strait of Hormuz closure; budget pressures from restricted Russian oil imports; free trade agreement with USA lingering; Operation Sindoor paused keeping Pakistan in check

The company is very bullish on Sriperumbudur and might even consider buying some more additional lands which is adjoining the existing ownerships so that it can use this land as plotted land and sell them at handsome profit.

The widening of the Thiruvallur road is proceeding at fast pace which will be helpful to the buyers and residents of our properties in Sriperumbudur whereas the Expressway to Bangalore is proceeding at snail's pace thereby bypassing so many completion schedule revision.
Management expects sale to be completed for the balance portion of the properties (Menon Eternity) within one year from the date of classification as held for sale.

The Company's capital requirement is mainly to fund its business expansion by developing various residential and commercial projects and repayment of borrowings. The principal source of funding has been, and is expected to continue to be, cash generated from operations supplemented by funding from banks, financial institutions and other lenders.

orders_or_contracts.statement: The company has signed agreements for the redevelopment of three apartment complexes in Chennai city.

Two large city projects under implementation with documentation completed; third project (12-storied, 180 apartments in South Chennai) documentation concluded; several re-development projects under negotiation

The company is now going into the situation of having opportunity to sell 1,07,000 sft of plotted lands and is now preparing for getting approval for plotting of further lands the company owns in Sriperumbudur.

Based on terms of contracts with customers, performance obligations are satisfied over time for under-construction real-estate projects and accordingly revenue is recognized over time. Significant judgments involved in assumptions and estimations in relation to cost of completion of projects under development.

Valuation of Inventory - The value of inventory amounting to Rs. 29,584.98 lakhs forms 72.07% of Company's total assets. Inventories carried at lower of cost and net realizable value (NRV). Determination of NRV involves estimates based on prevailing market conditions, current prices, expected date of commencement and completion, estimated future selling price, cost to complete projects.

Claims, litigation and contingencies - The Company has various ongoing legal disputes in the nature of tax matters and other legal matters. Management estimates possible outflow of economic resources based on legal status of proceedings.
